    About Volta

    Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

    About The Role

    Commissioning is where an AI factory becomes real. As Senior Director, Global Commissioning & Handover, you will lead commissioning of DSX facilities and network across all of Volta's sites, taking each one to ready for service and handing it over to our operations teams.

    You will build and lead a global team that owns Volta's commissioning standards for electrical, mechanical and CDU scopes, systems security, commissioning planning, facilities readiness and operational readiness. Your team sets how commissioning is done on every site, from tagging through to the turn-up sequence, and holds the schedule that takes each facility live.

    Time to market matters here. You will align commissioning to the turn-up sequence so that commissioning accelerates service rather than delays it, and you will make sure that when a building is handed over, the operations team, the procedures and the systems are ready to run it.

    What You Will Be Doing

    • Lead commissioning of DSX facilities and network infrastructure across Volta's AI factories, taking each site to ready for service.

    • Build and lead the global Commissioning and Handover team, covering electrical, mechanical and CDU commissioning standards, systems security, commissioning planning, facilities readiness and operational readiness.

    • Own Volta's commissioning standards for each discipline, from tagging and method statements through each commissioning level to the turn-up sequence.

    • Own CDU installation and commissioning standards, including handover to operations.

    • Own the commissioning schedule for every site and its alignment to turn-up, so that commissioning is never the critical path to service.

    • Deliver the physical and systems security requirements for each site from construction through tohandover.

    • Set the facilities readiness and operational readiness standards and governance, so each facility is ready for operations and the operations team is ready to run it.

    • Lead handover into service, working with DC Operations on acceptance, documentation and training.

    • Work with Design and Engineering, the regional delivery teams and the DSX execution and network teams so commissioning is integrated into the master schedule on every site.

    • Report commissioning progress and risk across sites, and feed lessons learned back into the standards and the reference design.

    What You Bring

    • Experience leading commissioning of hyperscale data centres, including electrical, mechanical and liquid cooling systems. Data centre experience is essential.

    • A track record owning commissioning and handover across multiple concurrent sites at this level, and the ability to run it from day one.

    • Deep knowledge of commissioning levels, integrated systems testing and the turn-up sequence for high density GPU environments.

    • Experience with CDU and liquid cooling commissioning and handover into operations.

    • Experience setting readiness governance and handing live facilities over to operations teams.

    • Experience building and leading commissioning teams and managing commissioning agents and contractors.

    • Understanding of physical and systems security requirements in mission critical facilities.

    • Willingness to travel to sites across Europe and North America.

    MVRDV zoekt een Senior Financial Controller om ons Finance & Operations team in Rotterdam te versterken.

    Je bent de financiële rechterhand van onze Head of Finance en de dagelijkse sparringpartner voor Project Managers, Directors en collega's binnen Finance. Je speelt een belangrijke rol in zowel project control als financial control en zorgt ervoor dat financiële informatie betrouwbaar, tijdig en bruikbaar is voor de organisatie.

    Je ondersteunt Project Managers bij het monitoren en verbeteren van projectresultaten, terwijl je tegelijkertijd bijdraagt aan een hoogwaardige financiële verslaggeving, een betrouwbare jaarafsluiting en een succesvolle accountantscontrole. Met jouw analytische blik, financiële expertise en hands-on mentaliteit lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan de verdere professionalisering van onze financiële organisatie.

    MVRDV is een wereldwijd erkend bureau voor architectuur en stedenbouw, met hoofdkantoor in Rotterdam en vestigingen in Shanghai, Parijs, Berlijn en New York. Opgericht in 1993 door Winy Maas, Jacob van Rijs en Nathalie de Vries, ontwerpt MVRDV innovatieve, sociaal verantwoorde en duurzame architectuur die de toekomst vormgeeft. Als collega bij MVRDV maak je deel uit van een energiek, internationaal team van meer dan 250 professionals uit meer dan 40 nationaliteiten.

    Verantwoordelijkheden

    Project Control

    • Samenwerken met Project Managers bij het opstellen en beoordelen van projectbudgetten, fee-calculaties en forecasts.

    • Financiële projectprestaties monitoren, waaronder omzet, kosten, marge, WIP en cashflow, en risico's en kansen tijdig signaleren.

    • Variantie- en scenarioanalyses uitvoeren en de resultaten vertalen naar praktisch advies over winstgevendheid, facturatie en cashflow.

    • Project Managers ondersteunen bij projectopstart, maandelijkse reviews en projectafsluiting.

    • Zorgen voor een correcte projectopzet, coderingsstructuren en kostentoewijzingen.

    • Urenregistraties en projecttoewijzingen controleren op juistheid en consistentie.

    • Inefficiënties in projectuitvoering signaleren en bijdragen aan margeverbetering.

    Financial Control

    • Verantwoordelijk voor de coördinatie en kwaliteitsbewaking van de financiële verslaggeving en de jaarrekening, inclusief relevante specificaties, balansdossiers en aansluitingen.

    • Verantwoordelijk voor de regie op de jaarlijkse accountantscontrole en de samenwerking met externe accountants, waarbij wordt gezorgd voor een efficiënte en succesvolle afronding van het controleproces.

    • Bewaken van de volledigheid en juistheid van financiële processen, interne beheersingsmaatregelen en financiële gegevens ter ondersteuning van een betrouwbare jaarafsluiting.

    • Signaleren van verbetermogelijkheden binnen financiële processen en bijdragen aan verdere professionalisering van de financiële organisatie.

    • Ondersteunen bij maand-, kwartaal- en jaarafsluitingen en zorgen voor betrouwbare financiële rapportages.

    Business Control & Business Partnering

    • Bijdragen aan bedrijfsbrede budgettering, forecasting en lange termijn planning.

    • Helpen bij het opstellen van managementrapportages, KPI-dashboards en financiële analyses.

    • Projectresultaten verbinden aan de totale financiële prestaties van de organisatie.

    • Projectbudgetten afstemmen op bezetting en capaciteitsplanning.

    • Financiële data vertalen naar heldere, bruikbare adviezen voor niet-financiële collega's.

    • Management ondersteunen bij business cases, scenarioanalyses en besluitvorming.


    Wie zoeken wij?

    • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in Finance, Bedrijfseconomie, Accountancy of vergelijkbaar.

    • Minimaal 7 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen financial control, business control, accountancy of een vergelijkbare financiële functie.

    • Aantoonbare ervaring met jaarafsluitingen, financiële verslaggeving en jaarrekeningen.

    • Ervaring met accountantscontroles en samenwerking met externe accountants.

    • Ervaring binnen een projectgedreven organisatie, bij voorkeur in architectuur, engineering, consultancy of een vergelijkbare omgeving.

    • Een sterk begrip van financiële rapportage, project accounting en interne beheersing.

    • Gevorderde Excel-vaardigheden en ervaring met ERP- en BI-tools.

    • Vloeiend Engels; Nederlands is een pré.

    • Analytisch, gestructureerd en kwaliteitsgericht.

    • In staat financiële vraagstukken begrijpelijk te maken voor niet-financiële stakeholders.

    • Proactief, zelfstandig en gericht op verbetering.



    Wat bieden wij?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    <\/span><\/li>\n<\/ul>\n

SumUp University is how we build a culture of continuous learning across the business, running leadership programmes, workshops, and development initiatives for SumUppers in every market except Brazil. About the team

SumUp's Point of Sale (POS) solution helps cafes, shops, bars, hair salons, and thousands of other businesses manage their day-to-day operations. Alongside the POS experience, merchants rely on powerful reporting, sales management, and fiscalisation tools to understand their business, stay compliant, and operate with confidence.

This role would own these three domains from a design perspective - Reporting, Sales, and Fiscalisation. You'll design the experiences merchants use to analyse performance, manage sales activity, and navigate local fiscal requirements, while helping shape a more unified reporting experience across SumUp's payments, banking, and commerce products.

You'll work closely with product managers, engineers, and data teams within POS, and collaborate with designers and stakeholders across SumUp to deliver experiences that are clear, trustworthy, and built to scale.

🎬 Take a look at our Berlin office

What you'll do

  • Lead end-to-end design across Reporting, Fiscalisation, and Sales domains - from discovery and strategy through to production-ready delivery
  • Drive the unification of reporting experiences across Dashboard and Mobile, making complex data clear and accessible for merchants
  • Design holistic flows - including sign-up, onboarding, and export experiences, that meet local regulatory requirements while remaining scalable globally
  • Establish UX patterns for presenting data-heavy, financial information consistently across SumUp products
  • Shape long-term product strategy by running discovery initiatives, influencing the roadmap, and acting as a trusted design partner for product and engineering

You'll be great for this role if…

  • You have a minimum of 5 years working as a Product Designer, with a portfolio that demonstrates end-to-end ownership across complex digital products.

About Huzzle Labs

Huzzle Labs partners with frontier AI labs to evaluate and improve frontier models through deep human expertise. Contributors directly assess advanced AI systems in their specialist fields, receive competitive compensation, and help define the standards used to measure model performance.

About the Role

Huzzle Labs is seeking experienced accountants to write realistic accounting tasks that test how well frontier AI systems handle accounting work. You will create prompts that are difficult enough for a frontier model to fail, then write a scoring rubric for each task so reviewers can assess the output consistently. A rubric is a list of objective, checkable criteria that a reviewer marks pass or fail. Your judgement helps define the standards used to measure model performance.

This is an expert judgement role focused on realistic task design, careful review of model output and precise, consistent documentation. Training is provided. Prior AI training or data-annotation experience is required.

Responsibilities

  • Write realistic accounting tasks: Create requests of the kind a client, controller or business owner would send, covering month-end close, bank and credit card reconciliations, AR/AP ageing, accruals and adjusting entries, sales tax, job costing and the clean-up of incomplete or inconsistent books.
  • Build from real material: Review a deal room containing hundreds of files, select the relevant documents and use them to develop prompts and rubrics for tasks a frontier model struggles to complete correctly.
  • Require usable deliverables: Each request should call for a working output, usually a spreadsheet, a journal entry schedule or a short memo.
  • Test against a frontier model: Run each request and review the output with the care you would apply when signing off accounting work. Where the model succeeds, increase the difficulty until a genuine gap appears.
  • Write scoring rubrics: Define objective criteria that another reviewer can apply without repeating your work, for example, “the reconciled ending balance equals $X” and “the $X deposit is recorded as a customer deposit liability, not revenue.”
  • Apply guidelines consistently: Follow the task and rubric guidelines, flag ambiguous cases and help refine the criteria.

  • At least 5 years in accounting, bookkeeping or finance operations.

  • Excellent written English and precision with numbers.
  • Careful and detail-oriented: accurate figures and objective, checkable criteria.
  • Available 20 to 40 hours per week for an initial one-week trial, with potential extension.

Example Assignment

For a client deal room covering a small business with incomplete and inconsistent books, you would:

  1. Review the files and select the relevant documents, such as bank statements, ledgers, invoices and ageing reports.
  2. Write a prompt as the business owner or controller would, asking for a reconciliation and the adjusting entries needed to close the month.
  3. Run the prompt against a frontier AI model and check the spreadsheet or journal entry schedule line by line.
  4. If the model completes the task correctly, increase the difficulty, for example, by adding a customer deposit, a timing difference or a sales tax complication, until it fails.
  5. Write the rubric, such as “the reconciled ending balance equals $X” and “the $X deposit is recorded as a customer deposit liability, not revenue,” so another reviewer can grade any answer without repeating the work.

At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution.

We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints.

With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge?

Research questions you could initially work on

  • Learning dynamics from operational data. How can we identify useful models of a plant from noisy, partially observed data collected during closed-loop control?

  • Optimising under uncertainty. How can Bayesian optimisation improve plant performance when experiments are expensive, samples are noisy, and operating constraints must be respected?

  • Learning while controlling. How can we use dual control and active learning to choose actions that improve performance while gathering information about uncertain dynamics?

  • Learning across plants. Which parts of a model or control strategy can transfer between plants, and how can we adapt them efficiently to a new site?

These are meant as examples rather than an exhaustive list. We’re looking for someone who can bring depth to a relevant area, identify promising connections, and help us decide which problems to tackle next.

Your main responsibilities

As a Research Scientist, you’ll:

  • Help shape our research and development agenda, turning challenges from live plants into well-defined research problems.

  • Develop and implement methods for modelling, identification, optimisation and control of complex physical systems.

  • Design rigorous experiments, establish strong baselines and understand when and why a method works.

  • Work with process engineers to incorporate plant physics, operating knowledge and constraints into models and algorithms.

  • Work with machine learning and deployment engineers to evaluate promising methods and bring them into production.

  • Follow deployed performance, investigate failures, and use what you learn to guide further research.

  • Communicate your findings clearly and contribute to the team’s scientific understanding.

What a great fit looks like

  • A PhD in control, machine learning, applied mathematics, engineering, physics or a related field, or equivalent research experience.

  • A strong research background in one or more of control theory, data-driven control, system identification, Bayesian optimisation, probabilistic modelling, physics-informed machine learning, imitation learning or model-based reinforcement learning.

  • Evidence that you can formulate a research question, develop a method and evaluate it carefully, through publications, open-source work or applied research.

  • Strong Python skills and experience implementing machine learning models using tools such as Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, PyTorch.

  • An interest in working closely with engineers and taking responsibility for how your methods perform in practice.

  • Practical experience deploying machine learning and control algorithms.

  • A strong interest in climate mitigation.

You don’t need to know about cement. You do need to get excited about the physics, willing to learn from operators and process engineers, and keen to understand why a plant behaves the way it does.

We don’t expect you to tick every box. If you bring depth in a relevant area and these problems excite you, we’d like to hear from you.

In return for your hard work, we’ll give you

📈 Equity in the company: When we win, you win. You’ll get share options, so you’re part of our journey from the inside.

🕰️ Flexible working We trust you to know how and when you work best and to work that out with your team.

🌴 30 days of holiday (plus bank holidays). Rest is productive. Take the time you need to recharge

🪙 A generous pension scheme. We’re planning for the future in more ways than one.

Our Operating Principles

↗️ Go Gig or Go Home: High Bar, All In. What we do matters to humanity, to our customers and to each other. We hold ourselves to an extraordinarily high bar and bring the urgency this mission requires.

🏭 Concrete Honesty: Be honest. As concrete forms the foundation of our world, genuine honesty and transparency are the bedrock of our culture.

🦾 Autonomous Ownership: High agency, high ownership. We build systems that take control and make things better. We do the same: see it, own it, drive it.

😄 Cement it with Kindness & Fun: Have fun, be kind. We're here to extend Earth's life, but ours is still limited. We want to enjoy the ride. To see these in full, go to Gigaton’s Operating Principles Notion page.

  • You have a product-focused mindset, meaning you don't just "write tickets" but actively think about how to make the user's life easier.

About Us

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

France is one of the most important flexibility markets in Europe. This role is critical to accelerating Axle’s growth in France.

About the role

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach in France.

At the core of our market expansion plans is market analysis. To maximise future revenue, we spend a lot of time understanding the value of flexibility in power markets around the world.

We are looking for a technical individual (data scientist, analyst or engineer) with strong knowledge of the French electricity markets and an instinct for commercial value.

You will become Axle’s internal expert on French power markets: understanding the market rules, modelling the value, and building relationships with system operators and regulators. We’re scrappy about method and rigorous about conclusions.

  • Developing a deep understanding of French energy markets and grid dynamics to understand how trading, compensation, penalties and cash flow work

  • Building and optimising models of wholesale/NEBCO, capacity, balancing, ancillary services and local flexibility markets in France to forecast what different assets can earn

  • Sizing the revenue opportunity across markets and products to shape where we expand next

  • Building and evaluating different strategies for cycling a battery or load-shifting an EV charger

  • Monitoring and shaping energy regulation to accelerate the growth of flexibility.

  • Deep quantitative and modelling ability (Python, SQL)

  • Exceptional communication and the ability to turn data into actionable commercial insights

  • Comfort moving fast and making decisions in an evolving environment

  • Deep knowledge of French electricity markets (NEBCO, Mécanisme de Capacité, Mécanisme d’Ajustement, ancillary services…)

  • Relationships with regulators, grid operators and other stakeholders (CRE, DGEC, RTE, Enedis, etc.) are a plus

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract (CDD). Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

You’ll be based in France. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

 

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

 

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

 

How it works

 

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

Terms

 

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

 

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

Job Summary:

We're looking for a Senior DevSecOps Engineer to build security into how ClearDATA ships software. You'll work closely with our R&D organization to secure CI/CD pipelines, harden build and deployment processes, and make sure security is part of engineering's workflow rather than a gate at the end of it


Work Mode: Remote

Shift Timings:Monday to Friday – 5:30pm IST to 2:30am IST

Pipeline & Build Security

  • Partner with R&D to design and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines, from code commit through deployment.
  • Integrate static and dynamic application security testing (SAST/DAST), dependency and container scanning, and secrets management into the development lifecycle.
  • Harden build systems, artifact repositories, and deployment tooling against common attack paths.
  • Own infrastructure-as-code security: reviewing and improving how Terraform, Kubernetes, and cloud configurations are written and deployed.

Partnership with R&D

  • Act as the security point of contact for engineering teams, helping them fix issues without slowing them down unnecessarily.
  • Review new tools, services, and architecture decisions for security implications before they ship.
  • Build automation and guardrails so secure practices are the path of least resistance for developers, not an extra step.

Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Work with the IT/ITSec Manager and Senior Compliance Analyst to make sure pipeline and infrastructure changes stay aligned with our compliance obligations.
  • Support incident response for anything touching build, deployment, or production infrastructure.
  • Help set and maintain security standards for software development lifecycle.undefined.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 7-8 years in DevOps, platform engineering, or security engineering, with real hands-on pipeline and infrastructure experience.
  • Direct experience securing CI/CD pipelines and build systems, not just running them.
  • Strong background with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or similar).
  • Comfortable with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with SAST/DAST tools, dependency scanning, and secrets management.
  • Able to work directly with engineers’ day to day and explain security tradeoffs in terms that land.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA, SOC 2, HITRUST, or GDPR is a plus, especially in healthcare or another regulated industry.

Good to have

  • Experience in a healthcare, fintech, or other regulated environment where security and compliance carry real weight.
  • Relevant certifications such as AWS/Azure/GCP security specialties, CKS, or similar.
  • A background writing your own tooling or automation rather than just configuring off-the-shelf products.

Soft Skills/ Behavioural Skills:

1. Excellent Communication Skills (Written & Verbal)

2. Working Independently.

3. Critical Thinking


Benefits:

  • Annual Public Holidays as applicable
  • 30 days total leave per calendar year
  • Mediclaim policy
  • Lifestyle Rewards Program
  • Group Term Life Insurance
  • Gratuity

About airSlate

airSlate is a global SaaS technology company that develops no-code workflow automation, electronic signature, and document management solutions. Our award-winning products - SignNow, pdfFiller, DocHub, altaFlow, Instapage, and US Legal Forms - serve over hundreds of millions of users and more than one million customers worldwide, helping organizations of every size digitize processes, improve efficiency, and transform how they work.
We’re in an exciting phase of growth and transformation, with teammates in more than 20 countries across three continents and main hubs in the United States, Poland, Ukraine and Philippines.
At airSlate, we’re building value for customers and a culture where growth and innovation go hand in hand. We’re looking for people eager to shape products, scale a company, and thrive in a fast-moving environment.

About the SignNow team

We are a passionate and ambitious team of 100+ people on a mission to succeed with our award-winning signature solution. SignNow empowers over 28 million people worldwide to move fast with everything they need to send and e-sign documents.
Now, we're looking to reimagine digital agreement workflows and build the next generation of SignNow through AI-native experiences.

About the role

As a Principal AI Product Manager, you will play a founding role in shaping SignNow 2.0, rethinking how customers prepare, execute, and manage digital agreements through intelligent, agentic experiences.
This isn't about simply adding AI features to an existing product. It's about identifying meaningful customer problems, challenging existing workflows, and creating fundamentally better experiences while maintaining the trust, transparency, and control customers expect from signNow.
This is a hands-on, entrepreneurial builder role with end-to-end product ownership, high autonomy, and the opportunity to shape the next generation of our product, backed by the scale, resources, and customer base of an established global company.
You'll work closely with engineering, design, data, and GTM teams to turn ambitious ideas into real customer value, validate solutions early, iterate quickly, and deliver measurable business impact.

What you will be working on:

  • Product vision & strategy: Define and execute the product vision and roadmap for AI-native agreement experiences, balancing near-term customer value with long-term strategic opportunities.

  • End-to-end product development: Own the full product lifecycle, from problem discovery and opportunity validation to prototyping, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.

  • AI-native experiences: Reimagine existing workflows and build intelligent, agentic experiences that solve meaningful customer problems, with a focus on reliability, transparency, and user control.

  • AI product & technical leadership: Define clear product requirements, working closely with engineering to evaluate technical trade-offs, ensure quality, and enable scalable execution.

  • Customer & market discovery: Proactively engage customers, uncover and simplify complex problems, identify market opportunities, and validate hypotheses through research, experimentation, and hands-on prototyping.

  • Business impact: Prioritize initiatives based on customer value, adoption, revenue potential, and ROI. Define success metrics and use evidence to drive product decisions.

  • Strategic influence & alignment: Turn complex ideas into clear, compelling product narratives, build alignment across stakeholders, and drive decisions that connect immediate opportunities with long-term direction.

  • Entrepreneurial execution: Take ownership, challenge assumptions, proactively remove blockers, and move quickly from ideas to measurable outcomes.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of end-to-end product management experience in high-growth or large-scale B2B/B2C SaaS companies.

  • Proven product ownership: Experience independently identifying new product opportunities and leading products or major initiatives from concept to launch and measurable business impact.

  • AI product expertise: Hands-on experience shipping AI-powered products, with strong product judgment around LLM capabilities, agentic workflows, quality evaluation, reliability, cost, and performance trade-offs.

  • Strong product discovery and problem-solving skills: Proven ability to proactively engage customers, uncover and simplify complex problems, validate opportunities, and translate insights into clear product requirements and measurable outcomes.

  • Strategic product thinking: Ability to identify market opportunities, develop a differentiated product point of view, make clear prioritization decisions, and connect short-term execution with long-term strategy.

  • Exceptional strategic communication and influence: Ability to turn complex ideas into clear, compelling product narratives, build alignment, and drive decisions across technical and business stakeholders.

  • Strong technical fluency: Ability to work effectively with engineering, understand architectural implications, evaluate trade-offs, and define technically feasible product requirements. Strong analytical understanding of product metrics, experimentation, and instrumentation.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset and high ownership: Comfortable with ambiguity, challenging existing approaches, taking initiative, and moving independently from ideas to execution.

  • Hands-on and experimental approach: Willingness to personally explore emerging technologies, prototype ideas, test assumptions, and continuously learn.

Nice to Have

  • Experience founding a startup, building independent products, or leading entrepreneurial initiatives, including ventures that didn't succeed.

  • Experience developing AI-native products or agentic workflows.

  • Experience with B2B workflow automation, document processing, or agreement management.

  • Experience with hands-on prototyping using AI development tools.

Sounds like a match? Apply and let’s explore how we can build impactful AI-powered products together.

What we offer

Flexible working environment - Our teams operate across the globe. We value in‑person collaboration in our hubs, but we also embrace remote and hybrid working. You can work from one of our offices in the United States, Poland, Romania or Ukraine, or remotely from many countries.
Competitive compensation and stock options - We offer salaries that reflect local market conditions and experience, plus a performance-based bonus system and stock options so you share in the company’s growth.
Professional growth and learning - We invest in your development through courses, conferences, and access to learning resources. We encourage career growth and internal mobility, supporting teammates who want to explore new opportunities within airSlate.
Health and well‑being - We provide comprehensive benefits tailored to each country, including health coverage, wellness programmes and access to fitness options. We also dedicate quarterly company-wide Mental Health Days, when everyone takes time off to rest and recharge.
Family‑friendly culture - Family life is part of who we are, and we embrace it in many forms. From flexibility for parents to our airSlate Junior Club for kids, to company-wide family days and our pet-friendly approach, we’re committed to making work and life easier to balance.
Giving back - We support charitable initiatives around the world through the airSlate Care programme. Our current focus includes humanitarian aid in Ukraine and other regions, matching employee donations and supporting causes chosen by our teams.
Open communication - We encourage transparent dialogue at all levels. From team discussions to company-wide Q&A sessions with our CEO, we make sure everyone has the chance to be heard and to influence how we grow.

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

About Grafana Labs:

There are more than 700,000 active installations of Grafana around the globe, monitoring everything from beehives to climate change in the Alps. The instantly recognizable dashboards have been spotted everywhere from a SpaceX launch and Minecraft HQ to Wimbledon and the Tour de France. Grafana Labs also helps companies including Bloomberg, JPMorgan Chase, and eBay manage their observability strategies with full-stack offerings that can be run fully managed with Grafana Cloud, or self-managed with Grafana Enterprise Stack. The Grafana stack has grown to include more open-source projects, including Grafana Loki (for logs) and Grafana Tempo (for traces) and Grafana Mimir (for metrics).

Description of Duties

We’re looking for a Staff Technical Writer to create documentation and learning content that helps people adopt and master Grafana’s observability products. You’ll work with engineers, product managers, and the Grafana writing team to produce content for a range of products and audiences, from first-time users to experienced practitioners. Because our products and priorities evolve, we’re looking for someone who learns new technical domains quickly.

AI is part of how this team works. We use AI-assisted workflows and tools throughout the content lifecycle, from research and drafting to review, validation, and maintenance. You’ll use these tools every day and help the team get better at using them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, research, write, and maintain documentation and learning content (concepts, tasks, tutorials, references, and in-product learning) that supports adoption and long-term product mastery.
  • Use AI tools and workflows to work faster and at a higher quality: drafting, structuring, technical validation, consistency checks, and keeping content current. You apply human judgment to everything AI produces and take responsibility for its accuracy.
  • Contribute to the team’s shared AI workflows and skills, and look for ways to improve and automate how we create and maintain content as tools and models evolve.
  • Partner with engineers, PMs, and other stakeholders to understand product requirements, interview subject matter experts, and turn complex technical detail into clear, accurate content.
  • Test what you document. Run the software, follow your own procedures, and flag product and UX gaps you find along the way.
  • Let data guide your priorities. We have strong docs and learning analytics. You’ll use them, along with user feedback, to find content gaps, prioritize your work, and show the impact of what you ship.
  • Work with the documentation manager and other writers to improve information architecture, voice, and consistency across our docs, and to make information easy to find for both people and AI-driven search and assistants.
  • Manage several projects at once, using judgment to prioritize and communicate clearly when the plan changes.
  • Mentor teammates and share practices that raise the quality of the team’s work.

Requirements

What experience would make someone be successful in this role?

  • Experience writing or documenting enterprise or developer-facing software, with a portfolio or writing samples that show technical depth.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools and models in your writing workflow (such as LLM assistants, agentic coding tools, or custom prompts and skills), and the ability to explain how you evaluate and verify their output.
  • Experience working with docs-as-code: command-line Git, GitHub (pull requests and reviews), Markdown, and common IDEs.
  • Comfort working in technical environments. You can set up, run, and troubleshoot software yourself to verify what you write (for example, command line, containers, or Kubernetes, or a willingness to learn quickly).
  • Experience collaborating with engineers and product managers to get accurate technical information.
  • Experience working remotely and asynchronously on a distributed team.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • Curiosity about AI as a craft. You treat AI workflows as a professional skill. You experiment, share what works, and know where AI helps and where it doesn’t.
  • Technical credibility. You care about accuracy, you learn new technical domains quickly, and you ask questions until you understand them.
  • Strong judgment and editing skills. You can tell good content from plausible-sounding content, and you hold the line on quality.
  • Ownership. You manage multiple projects and work well both independently and collaboratively.
  • Clarity. You write concisely and plainly for readers of all experience levels.
  • Bonus: Experience with observability, monitoring, or cloud-native tooling, or contributing to open source documentation.

Mission

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.

We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.

  • Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.
  • Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.
  • Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.
  • Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
  • The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more
  • An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

Solutions Architect (Engineering)

Position Overview

We're seeking a Solutions Architect to design innovative energy solutions that solve our customers' most critical challenges. You'll work at the intersection of customer needs, technical possibility, and commercial viability—translating complex requirements into compelling, profitable proposals that win business and deliver results.

In this role, you'll collaborate closely with Sales, Engineering, Product Management, and customers to create system-level designs for distributed power generation, energy storage, and critical power applications. You'll combine deep technical expertise with business acumen to deliver solutions that are both technically excellent and financially sound.

What You'll Do

Solution Design & Engineering

  • Design complete power and energy systems that meet customer technical requirements while achieving financial objectives
  • Perform dynamic modeling and engineering analysis to validate system performance
  • Develop project scope definitions, equipment specifications, and technical documentation
  • Conduct value engineering to optimize solutions for cost, performance, and reliability
  • Ensure designs comply with relevant codes, standards, and customer specifications

Customer Engagement & Technical Sales Support

  • Lead technical discovery sessions with customers to understand requirements and constraints
  • Conduct site visits and technical assessments to inform solution design
  • Present technical solutions to customer stakeholders, from facilities managers to executives
  • Address technical questions and objections throughout the sales cycle
  • Build trusted advisor relationships through technical credibility and customer focus
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for diverse audiences

Proposal Development & Commercial Support

  • Develop comprehensive technical proposals that differentiate our solutions
  • Collaborate with Sales to create winning strategies for competitive opportunities
  • Define project budgets, timelines, and resource requirements
  • Assess technical risks and develop mitigation strategies
  • Support contract negotiations with technical expertise and clarifications
  • Ensure proposal quality, consistency, and alignment with company standards

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work with Engineering teams to apply new technologies and products to customer applications
  • Partner with Finance to develop accurate cost models and financial projections
  • Coordinate with Project Management and Service Operations on solution feasibility and delivery
  • Provide customer feedback to Product Management to inform product development
  • Collaborate with other Solutions Architects to share knowledge and best practices
  • Support the transition from sales to delivery, ensuring continuity and technical accuracy

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

  • Stay current on industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitive solutions
  • Identify opportunities to improve solution design processes and tools
  • Contribute to the development of standard designs, templates, and best practices
  • Participate in post-project reviews to capture lessons learned
  • Build technical expertise through training, research, and hands-on learning

Why This Role Matters

As a Solutions Architect, you'll play a critical role in our growth and customer success. The solutions you design will directly impact our ability to win business and deliver value to customers who depend on reliable, sustainable energy. You'll work on meaningful projects that improve energy reliability, reduce costs, and support the transition to cleaner power.

This role offers significant growth potential within a dynamic organization. You'll develop both technical depth and business acumen, with mentorship from experienced leaders and exposure to strategic projects. As our business grows, high-performing Solutions Architects can advance to senior technical roles or move into leadership positions.

Our Environment

You'll work in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where technical excellence and customer focus are paramount. We value innovation, continuous improvement, and bold thinking. You'll have access to cutting-edge technologies, challenging projects, and a team committed to pushing the boundaries of what's possible in clean energy solutions.

We support your professional development with training, mentorship, and opportunities to work on increasingly complex and strategic projects. Your expertise and contributions will be recognized, and you'll have a clear path to grow your impact and career.

  • Strong technical foundation with demonstrated ability to learn and master new technologies

  • Experience creating technical proposals and customer-facing documentation
  • Excellent communication skills—able to present complex technical information clearly to diverse audiences
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and systems-thinking approach

  • Track record of winning complex technical sales
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment

Technical Competencies

  • System-level design and integration thinking
  • Technical modeling and performance analysis

  • Engineering documentation and technical writing

  • Customer-focused problem solving

Professional Competencies

  • Strong customer orientation and relationship building

Position:Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead the financial strategy, financial performance, capital management, investment finance, treasury, reporting, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investment organization.

The CFO will serve as a key member of the executive leadership team and strategic advisor to the CEO/President and Board, providing leadership across financial planning, insurance accounting, capital and solvency management, investment portfolio performance, asset-liability management, treasury, risk, regulatory reporting, and corporate development.

The successful candidate will combine deep financial expertise with strong commercial and investment acumen and will be capable of operating in a highly regulated financial-services environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Strategy & Executive Leadership

Develop and execute the organization's overall financial strategy.

Advise the CEO, President, and Board on financial performance, capital allocation, investment strategy, and enterprise value creation.

Translate corporate strategy into financial plans, budgets, forecasts, and measurable objectives.

Lead financial decision-making across insurance, investment, and corporate operations.

Establish strong financial governance and accountability across the organization.

2. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Performance

Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning.

Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support strategic decisions.

Monitor revenue, profitability, expenses, capital efficiency, and operating performance.

Establish financial KPIs and executive dashboards.

Identify opportunities to improve profitability, efficiency, and shareholder returns.

3. Insurance Finance & Performance

Oversee financial management of insurance operations, including premiums, claims, reserves, expenses, and underwriting performance.

Monitor key insurance financial metrics including loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting profitability.

Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk teams to assess financial performance and emerging exposures.

Ensure appropriate financial treatment and reporting of insurance liabilities and reserves.

Support pricing, product profitability, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions from a financial perspective.

4. Investment Finance & Portfolio Management

Provide financial oversight of the organization's investment portfolio and investment activities.

Partner with the CIO/Chief Investment Officer and Investment Committee on portfolio strategy and performance.

Monitor investment income, realized/unrealized gains, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted returns.

Evaluate investment opportunities and strategic asset-allocation decisions.

Ensure investment activities are aligned with the organization's liabilities, liquidity requirements, risk appetite, and regulatory requirements.

5. Capital, Solvency & Balance Sheet Management

Lead capital planning and balance-sheet optimization.

Monitor solvency, capital adequacy, liquidity, leverage, and financial resilience.

Develop strategies to optimize the organization's capital structure and return on capital.

Assess the financial impact of major business, investment, and insurance decisions on capital requirements.

Work closely with Risk and Actuarial functions on capital and solvency assessments.

6. Asset-Liability Management (ALM)

Provide executive financial oversight of asset-liability management.

Ensure investment portfolios are appropriately aligned with insurance liabilities and liquidity requirements.

Monitor duration, interest-rate sensitivity, liquidity gaps, and market exposures.

Support development of ALM strategies and balance-sheet optimization initiatives.

Ensure appropriate financial stress testing and scenario analysis.

7. Treasury & Liquidity

Oversee treasury, cash management, liquidity planning, and banking relationships.

Maintain adequate liquidity to meet claims, operating obligations, investment commitments, and strategic requirements.

Optimize cash deployment and short-term investment strategies.

Monitor interest-rate, foreign-exchange, credit, and liquidity exposures.

Establish robust treasury policies and controls.

8. Regulatory & Financial Reporting

Ensure accurate, timely, and transparent financial reporting to the Board, shareholders, regulators, and other stakeholders.

Oversee statutory accounts, management reporting, regulatory returns, and consolidated financial statements.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and insurance regulations.

Lead relationships with external auditors, regulators, actuarial advisers, tax advisers, and other professional stakeholders.

Maintain strong financial controls and governance frameworks.

9. Risk Management & Financial Controls

Establish effective financial risk-management frameworks.

Monitor exposure to market, credit, liquidity, underwriting, operational, interest-rate, and foreign-exchange risks.

Strengthen internal controls, financial policies, and governance processes.

Work closely with the CRO, Chief Actuary, CIO, and other executives to manage enterprise-wide financial risks.

Ensure appropriate stress testing and contingency planning.

10. Reinsurance & Capital Optimization

Provide financial oversight of reinsurance strategy and economics.

Evaluate the financial and capital implications of reinsurance arrangements.

Monitor reinsurance recoverables, counterparty exposure, and profitability.

Support optimization of risk transfer, capital efficiency, and balance-sheet resilience.

11. Corporate Development & Strategic Investments

Lead financial evaluation of acquisitions, strategic investments, joint ventures, and business expansion opportunities.

Oversee financial due diligence, valuation, transaction modeling, and investment cases.

Assess potential M&A opportunities and their impact on capital, solvency, earnings, and shareholder value.

Support negotiations with investors, financial institutions, and strategic partners.

12. Investor & Stakeholder Relations

Develop strong relationships with shareholders, institutional investors, banks, rating agencies, regulators, and other financial stakeholders.

Communicate financial performance, capital strategy, investment results, and business outlook to key stakeholders.

Support investor presentations, Board materials, and strategic financial communications.

13. Finance Transformation & Technology

Modernize finance systems, reporting infrastructure, ERP platforms, and financial analytics.

Improve automation, data quality, forecasting, and management reporting.

Establish real-time visibility into financial, insurance, investment, and risk performance.

Drive continuous improvement within the finance function.

14. Leadership & Talent Development

Lead Finance, FP&A, Treasury, Accounting, Financial Reporting, Tax, and related functions.

Build a high-performing and commercially focused finance organization.

Develop finance leadership talent and succession plans.

Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, financial discipline, and business partnership.

Key Performance Indicators

The CFO will be accountable for:

Revenue and earnings growth

Operating and net profitability

Return on equity (ROE)

Return on capital

Capital adequacy and solvency

Investment portfolio performance

Investment income and risk-adjusted returns

Combined ratio / underwriting profitability

Expense efficiency

Liquidity and cash-flow management

Balance-sheet optimization

Budget and forecast accuracy

Regulatory and financial reporting quality

Cost of capital

Financial risk management

Shareholder value creation

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

15+ years of progressive finance experience, including significant executive leadership.

Previous experience as CFO, Group CFO, Finance Director, VP Finance, Deputy CFO, or equivalent.

Significant experience within insurance, asset management, investment management, banking, pensions, financial services, or a related regulated financial institution.

Strong understanding of insurance financial statements, investment portfolios, capital management, and regulatory requirements.

Proven experience managing complex balance sheets, liquidity, capital, and financial performance.

Strong experience working with Boards, regulators, auditors, investors, rating agencies, and senior executives.

Demonstrated experience in financial strategy, investment analysis, and capital allocation.

Preferred Experience

Experience as Group CFO within a diversified insurance or financial-services group.

Experience across both insurance and investment/asset-management businesses.

Experience with life insurance, general insurance, health insurance, pensions, or reinsurance.

Exposure to institutional investment portfolios and alternative investments.

Experience with M&A, strategic investments, capital raising, restructuring, or corporate transformation.

Experience operating across multiple jurisdictions or regulated markets.

Experience interacting with insurance regulators and rating agencies.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

MBA or Master's degree in Finance/Business is an advantage.

Relevant insurance, actuarial, investment, or risk-management qualifications are advantageous.

Core Competencies

Insurance Finance

Corporate Finance

Investment Finance

Capital & Solvency Management

Asset-Liability Management

Treasury & Liquidity

Financial Planning & Analysis

Investment Analysis

Financial Modeling

Risk Management

Regulatory Reporting

Insurance Accounting

M&A & Corporate Development

Capital Allocation

Investor Relations

Corporate Governance

Financial Transformation

Leadership Characteristics

The successful CFO will be:

Strategic, commercially minded, and financially rigorous

Highly analytical and investment-oriented

Experienced in highly regulated environments

Strong in capital and balance-sheet management

Comfortable engaging with Boards, regulators, investors, and rating agencies

Able to balance growth, profitability, liquidity, capital, and risk

An effective strategic partner to the CEO, CIO, CRO, and Chief Actuary

Strong in complex financial decision-making

A transformational finance leader capable of building high-performing teams

Compensation

A competitive executive compensation package comprising base salary, performance-based incentives, executive benefits, and other benefits commensurate with experience and market benchmarks.

As the Technical Deputy Program Manager, serving as the Program Manager’s principal deputy and Lawelawe’s senior representative on the contract. Reporting to and supporting the Program Manager, you will guide technical resources, oversee software development from initial design through release, and coordinate Lawelawe personnel and subcontractor support. During planned or unplanned Program Manager absences, you will assume delegated authority for daily program operations to maintain continuity, customer support, and timely delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Support the Program Manager in directing daily contract operations, coordinating resources, and meeting program objectives.
  • Serve as acting Program Manager during planned or unplanned absences, exercising delegated authority to maintain operations, customer support, and required deliverables.
  • Serve as the senior representative and the primary link between Lawelawe corporate leadership and the program team.
  • Represent Lawelawe; coordinate subcontractor activities, monitor assigned performance, and resolve or escalate staffing and execution issues through established contract channels.
  • Supervise assigned Lawelawe and Program Management Office (PMO) employees, including workload assignments, performance reviews, coaching, and employee development.
  • Coordinate hiring activities with Talent Acquisition and address employee relations and corrective actions in coordination with HR.
  • Guide daily execution across software engineering, development operations, cybersecurity, systems integration, and other applicable technical workstreams.
  • Translate contractual requirements and agency objectives into technical priorities, requirements, specifications, and executable workflows.
  • Manage software development projects from design through completion, including analysis, design, development of enhancements and new modules, testing, evaluation, and release.
  • Partner with the Program Manager and Product Owners to define product strategy, forecast development needs, and plan and execute the product roadmap.
  • Research product development options and recommend technical approaches and product direction.
  • Facilitate Agile/Scrum ceremonies and technical governance reviews, providing teams with clear direction, resources, and realistic schedule and cost estimates.
  • Coordinate deployment of functional improvements within approved release schedules and promote continuous technical improvement.
  • Partner with the Program Manager to manage scope, schedule, resources, and cost baselines and track performance against contract requirements.
  • Identify program risks, operational bottlenecks, and engineering issues; implement corrective actions and escalate matters requiring additional authority.
  • Work with the Program Director, Program Manager, customer, technical leads, and program staff to meet staffing and performance needs.
  • Coordinate with Government stakeholders, corporate leadership, subcontractors, and program teams to align priorities and resolve technical and operational issues.
  • Prepare program reports, deliverables, executive briefings, and written updates that clearly communicate technical metrics, progress, risks, and decisions needed.

The Team

Our team brings together program management and technical professionals who work collaboratively to support customer priorities. You will partner with program leadership, development teams, corporate support functions, and subcontractors to deliver reliable solutions and maintain consistent program performance.

Here's What You Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • At least seven (7) years of experience in software product design, development, release, and delivery, including at least five (5) years of management or leadership experience within a software development organization and at least two (2) years managing a Scrum team.
  • Demonstrated ability to serve as a program’s second in charge and assume daily program leadership during the Program Manager’s absence.
  • Ability to serve as senior contract representative, lead assigned employees, coordinate subcontractor support, and communicate with Government and corporate leadership.
  • Experience with risk management, issue resolution, and problem-solving.
  • Knowledge of system architectures, networks, and operations.
  • United States citizenship and ability to provide proof of citizenship.
  • Ability to successfully complete required background screening and satisfy applicable Government suitability requirements to obtain a Public Trust.

Additional Qualifications

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical information to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-resolution skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and provide strategic direction.
  • Ability to anticipate and respond proactively to technical and operational challenges.
  • Experience applying Agile principles and Scrum methodology across development teams.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and professional development.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Relevant domain certifications such as ITIL, CISSP, or AWS/Azure architect certifications.

Work Location

This is a remote position located in San Antonio, Texas.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage.
  • Company-sponsored retirement plans with matching contributions.
  • Professional development and continued learning opportunities.
  • Additional perks and discounts available to employees.

Team: Sales / Solution Engineering

Mindset:Own the technical win.

About Nametag

Nametag is a category leader in identity verification, security, and account protection. We sell into security-conscious enterprises with complex environments, and high technical standards. Our Solutions Engineers are trusted technical partners to both customers and Account Executives—and are accountable for proving value, not just explaining it.

We value intellectual curiosity, collaboration, and a strong sense of responsibility in protecting enterprise security.

About the Role

We’re hiring an Enterprise Solutions Engineer to own the technical motion in complex enterprise deal cycles. This role partners directly with Account Executives to drive new business and expansion, assisting with discovery, shaping technical strategy, and running proofs-of-concept that align to the buyer’s security, identity, and implementation criteria.

This is not a demo jockey role. You are responsible for the technical win—from first technical conversation through POC success and into a clean, confident handoff to post-sales. You’ll stay engaged through implementation to ensure what was sold is what gets delivered, on time and against the buyer’s stated objectives.

Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with Account Executives to drive the technical validation for enterprise new business and expansion opportunities.
  • Lead deep technical discovery to understand customer identity architecture, security posture, and success criteria.
  • Own and execute enterprise-grade demos andproof-of-concept, clearly tied to documented success criteria reflecting customer requirements around relevant use cases,, risk factors, and decision criteria.
  • Articulate Nametag’s value in the context of IAM, authentication flows, and account protection—not just product features.
  • Serve as the primary technical adviser during the sales cycle, building trust with security, IT, and identity stakeholders.
  • Define clear technical success criteria and acceptance standards for each deal.
  • Own thehandover to post-sales, ensuring Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Technical Customer Engineering teams have full context.
  • Provide continuity and technical oversight during implementation to ensure onboarding stays aligned with what was sold and agreed.
  • Surface product gaps, competitive insights, and recurring objections to Product and Leadership.
  • Support renewals and expansions as necessary by re-engaging on architecture changes, new use cases, integration opportunities, and evolving security requirements.

Tech You’ll Work With

  • Identity and access management platforms: Okta, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Auth0, Ping, Duo
  • Authentication and federation standards: SAML, OIDC, OAuth, SSO, MFA
  • Enterprise IT and workflow systems: ServiceNow, custom internal platforms
  • REST APIs, webhooks, and modern SaaS architectures
  • Cloud environments and enterprise security tooling
  • Customer demo, POC, and evaluation environments

Qualifications

Work Authorization (Required): Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without current or future need for visa sponsorship. This is a firm requirement. The technical qualifications below are guidelines.

  • 5+ years experience in Pre-sales Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, or Technical Consulting in B2B SaaS.
  • Strong background in IAM, cybersecurity, or enterprise infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with SAML SSO, identity federation, and enterprise authentication flows.
  • Proven track record running successful enterprise POCs and technical evaluations.
  • Comfortable engaging with senior technical buyers (Security, IAM, IT Architecture).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills—able to explain complex systems clearly and credibly.
  • Bonus: Experience supporting post-sale implementations or working closely with Customer Success teams.

Who Will Succeed in This Role If

  • You take personal ownership of the technical win.
  • You think demos should prove outcomes, not just show features.
  • You’re comfortable pushing back when a POC is poorly scoped or misaligned.
  • You care deeply about clean handoffs and long-term customer success.
  • You enjoy complex environments where trust, clarity, and execution matter.

Why Join

You’ll work on high-impact enterprise deals where technical credibility is decisive. You’ll partner closely with Sales, Product, and Customer Success leadership, influence how we sell and onboard at scale, and help define Nametag’s technical reputation in the market.

Culture & Perks

At Nametag, we believe trust starts with how we treat each other. We're a remote-first team that values autonomy, inclusivity, and collaboration, with regular in-person time to stay connected and innovate together.

  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere in the US. Our team spans Seattle, San Francisco, Ann Arbor, Denver, New York City, and beyond.
  • Off-sites: We bring the team together once per quarter for in-person collaboration, often off-site in new places.
  • Flexible schedules: Work in your own time zone; we align key meetings across a shared window.

We Offer

  • Meaningful equity ownership
  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Quarterly team off-sites and travel support
  • New computer hardware and equipment
  • An inclusive environment where your voice has impact and your work drives change

🌍 Hello World!

We are The Codest - International Tech Software Company with tech hubs in Poland delivering global IT solutions and projects. Our core values lie in “Customers and People First” approach that prioritises the needs of our customers and a collaborative environment for our employees, enabling us to deliver exceptional products and services.

Our expertise centers on web development, cloud engineering, DevOps and quality. After many years of developing our own product - Yieldbird, which was honored as a laureate of the prestigious Top25 Deloitte awards, we arrived at our mission: to help tech companies build impactful product and scale their IT teams through boosting IT delivery performance. Through our extensive experience with product development challenges, we have become experts in building digital products and scaling IT teams.

But our journey does not end here - we want to continue our growth. If you’re goal-driven and looking for new opportunities, join our team! What awaits you is an enriching and collaborative environment that fosters your growth at every step.

💡Project Description:

Requirements

  • Support the delivery of scalable, reliable, and maintainable DevOps-driven solutions.

🔑 Key Requirements:

  • Min. 5 years of professional experience in DevOps role.

  • Design, implement, and manage AWS cloud infrastructure.

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitLab.

  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and improve reliability.

  • Implement security, backup, and disaster recovery best practices.

  • Work closely with development and operations teams to support software releases.

  • Fluent English.

📌Recruitment process:
